ev.q: In 2021, the U.S. age-adjusted drug overdose death rate involving cocaine was 7.3 deaths per 100,000 standard population.
The highest rate was in Region 1 (14.8)
Rates were higher in HHS regions 1–5 (mostly areas east of the Mississippi River) and were lower in regions 6–10
Age-adjusted drug overdose death rates were calculated using the direct method and the 2000 U.S. population.
Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data, 2021.
